title: Largest Estate Gift in Butler History to Permanently Endow Full Tuition Scholarship Program
summary_en: Butler University recently received a gift of more than $12.6 million, the largest estate gift in University history, from the late Margaret Ice Morey ’29 and Albert Morey, Sr., which will be used to permanently endow an existing scholarship program that annually awards 10 full tuition scholarships to high-achieving Marion County students with financial need.…
author: jennifer gunnels
title_cn: Largest Estate Gift in Butler History to Permanently Endow Full Tuition Scholarship Program
